auth.sousTitre: Sign in to your CSImmo workspace
auth.accrocheTexte: Rent, receipts, owner payouts and reminders in one place, on your own servers.
auth.point1: Buildings, units and leases tracked in real time
auth.point2: Receipts issued as soon as rent is collected
auth.point3: Your data stays with you, encrypted and backed up

installation.sousTitre: It only takes a few minutes: import your licence, then create the administrator account.
installation.empreinteAide: Send this fingerprint to the publisher to get your licence file (.lic).
installation.empreinteIndisponible: Fingerprint unavailable: set the IMMOGEST_MACHINE_ID variable on the server.
installation.contenuLicenceAide: Choose the file or paste its content.
installation.fichierTropGros: This file is too large to be a licence
installation.contactAide: Enter at least a phone number or an e-mail: it will be your sign-in identifier.
installation.contactRequis: Enter a phone number or an e-mail
installation.indisponible: The CSImmo server cannot be reached. Check that it is running, then reload the page.

parametres.licenceDescription: Status of your annual licence, server fingerprint and import of a new licence.
parametres.modeleBailDescription: Landlord, preamble, clauses and footer of the lease PDF.
parametres.notificationsDescription: SMS, WhatsApp, e-mail and push: credentials, log and retries.
parametres.relancesDescription: Reminder levels (D-5, D+3…), formal notice period.
parametres.paiementEnLigneDescription: Mobile Money aggregator credentials and payment tracking.
parametres.importDescription: Bring in data from Excel or CSV: buildings, units, tenants, leases and balances.
parametres.conformiteDescription: Personal data: consents, processing register, erasure requests.
parametres.utilisateursDescription: Access accounts: creation, password, activation and unlocking.

utilisateurs.description: Access accounts: administrators, managers, tenants, owners and service providers.
utilisateurs.genererAide: 12 random characters. Write it down: it is not shown again after this step.
utilisateurs.recapTitre: Give these credentials to the user
utilisateurs.recapAide: This password is not shown again. The user can change it after their first sign-in.
utilisateurs.copieImpossible: Copy failed: write the credentials down.

acces.aide: Creates a "Tenant" account identified by {contact}, linked to this record. Then give the password to the tenant.
acces.deja: An account is linked to this tenant.
acces.contactRequis: Enter a phone number or an email on the record to create their access.
acces.lienEchoue: The account was created but could not be linked to the record (do not create it again: link it from the record's edit page).

erreurs.contact: A phone number or an email is required.
erreurs.motDePasse: The password must be 8 to 100 characters long.

licence.lectureSeule: The application is read-only: you can view and export your data, but not create or change anything.
licence.jours: {count, plural, =0 {Expires today} one {# day} other {# days}}
licence.expireDepuis: Expired {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago
licence.empreinteAide: To send to the publisher to obtain or transfer a licence.
licence.grace: {count, plural, =0 {Less than a day} one {# day} other {# days}} left before an online verification is required.
licence.importAide: Renewal, tier change or transfer: choose the new .lic file. Import remains possible even if the current licence has expired.
licence.contenuRequis: Choose a file or paste the licence content
licence.adminSeulement: Only an administrator can import a licence.
licence.chargementErreur: Could not load the licence status.
licence.fichierTropGros: This file is too large to be a licence

bandeau.AUCUNE: No licence is installed: the application is read-only.
bandeau.EXPIREE: Your licence has expired: the application is read-only. Import a new licence.
bandeau.INVALIDE: Your licence is invalid: the application is read-only.
bandeau.REVOQUEE: Your licence has been revoked: the application is read-only. Contact the publisher.
bandeau.VERIFICATION_REQUISE: No online verification for over 30 days: the application is read-only. Restore the server's Internet connection.
bandeau.expireBientot: Your licence expires {jours, plural, =0 {today} one {in # day} other {in # days}} (on {date}). Remember to renew it.
bandeau.graceBientotFinie: Online verification has failed for several weeks: {jours, plural, =0 {less than a day} one {# day} other {# days}} left before read-only mode.

patrimoine.gpsInvalide: Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither
patrimoine.archiverImmeubleDescription: It will disappear from the lists. Its data is kept. Its units must be archived first.
patrimoine.archiverLotDescription: It will disappear from the lists and no longer count towards your licence tier. An occupied unit cannot be archived.

tiers.contactRequis: Enter a phone number or an e-mail
tiers.cniAide: Encrypted in the database; only visible to administrators and managers.
tiers.archiverDescription: The record disappears from the lists but its data is kept.
tiers.piecesAide: Files are encrypted before storage; only administrators, managers and the tenant concerned can open them.

baux.aucunGarant: This tenant has no registered guarantor.
baux.recapAide: The lease is created as a draft: you can preview the PDF before activating it. Activation marks the unit as occupied.

erreurs.dateFin: The end must be after the start.

baux.activerDescription: The unit will become occupied and a PDF copy will be generated. Terms can no longer be edited.
baux.preavisReduit: Both parties accept a shorter notice
baux.renouvellementAide: The new lease starts the day after this one ends and keeps its terms, except those you specify.

modele.aide: These texts feed the lease PDF. The layout is fixed; only these texts can be edited.
modele.clauses: Clauses (separate articles with a blank line)
modele.lectureSeule: Only an administrator can edit the template.

erreurs.reference: The reference is required for this method.

documents.aucun: No rent receipt or payment slip yet.

notifications.intro: Enter your providers' credentials. Secrets are encrypted and never shown again. A failed message is retried 3 times, then shown in the log.

aide.SMS: Any HTTP provider. In the body template, {to}, {from} and {message} are replaced. The authentication header is optional.
aide.WHATSAPP: WhatsApp Cloud API. Create an approved message template whose body has a {{1}} variable.
aide.PUSH: Firebase Cloud Messaging: project id and service account JSON.

relances.intro: Unpaid instalments, reminders sent on the first available channel (WhatsApp, then push, then SMS) and formal notices.
relances.confirmerMedDescription: An official document listing all of {nom}'s arrears will be generated and numbered. This cannot be undone.

parametres.aide: Levels are days relative to the due date: -5 = 5 days before, 3 = 3 days after. The largest level unlocks issuing a formal notice.
parametres.lectureSeule: Only an administrator can change these settings.
parametres.niveauxInvalides: Enter whole numbers separated by commas.
parametres.delaiInvalide: The period is between 1 and 90 days.

reversements.intro: Monthly payout = rent and charges collected − management fees − expenses charged. Calculate, check the statement preview, then validate: the statement is then frozen and numbered.
reversements.sansMandat: No mandate on the collection date
reversements.payerNom: Mark the payout of {nom} as paid
reversements.aucun: No payout for this month. Click “Calculate the month”.
reversements.confirmerValidationDescription: The payout of {nom} ({net}) will be frozen and its management statement numbered. This month's expenses can no longer be changed.

signalements.intro: Problems reported by tenants from the mobile app. Take them on, then mark them resolved or rejected.

paiementEnLigne.intro: Enter your merchant account credentials at the payment aggregator, and give it the webhook address below. Secrets are encrypted and never shown again. A payment is only recorded once the operator has confirmed it.
paiementEnLigne.urlWebhook: Webhook address to give the aggregator: {url}

sauvegardes.intro: A full backup (database, files, encryption key) is made every day at {heure}. Also keep a copy outside this server.
sauvegardes.demandee: Backup requested: it starts in a few seconds.
sauvegardes.restaurationDemandee: Restore requested: the application will restart, wait a few minutes then sign in again.
sauvegardes.autreVersion: Backup from version {version}: it cannot be restored from this screen (see the update documentation).

operation.restaurationEnCours: Restore in progress: keep this page open, the application will restart.

sauvegardes.restaurationAvertissement: All current data will be replaced by this backup's (a safety backup is made first). The application will be unavailable for a few minutes.

alerte.SAUVEGARDE_ABSENTE: No backup exists: your data is not protected.
alerte.SAUVEGARDE_ANCIENNE: The last backup is more than 48 hours old.
alerte.COPIE_EXTERNE_ABSENTE: No external copy is configured: a server failure or theft would lose the backups.
alerte.DERNIERE_OPERATION_ECHEC: The last backup or restore operation failed.
alerte.DISQUE_FAIBLE: Low disk space: free some room.
alerte.LICENCE_INVALIDE: The licence is not valid: the application is read-only.
alerte.LICENCE_PROCHE: The licence is about to expire.

import.intro: Bring in your buildings, units, tenants, current leases and opening balances from Excel or CSV. The import is all-or-nothing: on any error, nothing is saved.
import.pret: No errors: the file can be imported.
import.rienEcrit: Nothing was saved. Fix the file and try again.
import.tronque: The first {n} errors of {total} are shown.
import.confirmationTexte: The buildings, units, tenants and leases in the file will be created. Leases become active; earlier history is treated as paid, except the balances given.

conformite.demandesAide: Right to erasure (law no. 2024/017): anonymisation erases personal data and keeps accounting entries and documents. It is irreversible and impossible while a lease is running or arrears remain.

obstacles.BAIL_EN_COURS: A lease is running: wait for it to end.
obstacles.IMPAYES: Arrears remain: the debt justifies keeping the data.
obstacles.BIENS_GERES: Buildings are still attached to this owner.

conformite.motifRefusLabel: Reason for refusal (given to the person)
conformite.confirmationTexte: Name, contacts, address, profession, identity documents and account will be erased. This cannot be undone. Accounting documents and financial entries are kept.
conformite.conserveTitre: To tell the person: what is kept
conformite.modelesAide: Texts to read or have signed. Replace {RESPONSABLE} with the name of your agency or company.
conformite.effacementAide: The request is handled in Settings > Compliance.
